title: pvInterpolatetoQuadraturePoints
body:
## pvInterpolatetoQuadraturePoints

Interpolates every point array of the input to the quadrature points of each cell, using the selected quadrature offset array, and stores the results as field-data arrays of the same names (linked to the offset array); the mesh is unchanged. The quadrature tools work in sequence: pvGenerateQuadratureSchemeDictionary adds a cell offset array QuadratureOffset carrying the quadrature rules, pvInterpolatetoQuadraturePoints evaluates point fields at the quadrature points, and pvGenerateQuadraturePoints turns them into a point cloud.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The input needs an offset array with a quadrature dictionary, normally from pvGenerateQuadratureSchemeDictionary; otherwise nothing is computed and ParaView only warns.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `InterpolatetoQuadraturePoints`. Identity: `filters/QuadraturePointInterpolator`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet).
